quote: Every experiment so far uses the real zeros, whose fluctuation is a complicated superposition of many prime frequencies plus whatever the truncation misses.
problem: The chapter's own preceding section on permutation and surrogate tests describes experiments whose targets are not the real zeros: refits to shuffled, phase-randomized and IAAFT surrogate fluctuations, plus a held-out variant on permuted targets. So "every experiment so far" is literally false; only the held-out prediction tests on true targets (Tables I--III, the interpolation split) use the real zeros.
fix: Every held-out prediction test so far (apart from the surrogate refits) uses the real zeros, whose fluctuation is a complicated superposition of many prime frequencies plus whatever the truncation misses.
